name: Select GMMA operand major modes from tensor layouts
summary: Translate global operand layout tags into Hopper GMMA K-major or MN-major operand modes before selecting the tiled MMA.

strategy.intent: Construct a legal and performance-relevant GEMM tile mapping for the target architecture.
strategy.mechanism: Derive GMMA::Major values independently for A and B, including RS and SS-specific layout rules.
strategy.expected_benefit: Exposes data reuse and parallel Tensor Core work while respecting layout and resource limits.
tradeoffs: Tile choices change shared-memory use, register pressure, occupancy, and available grid parallelism.

parameters.name: gmma_major_a
parameters.description: Tunable or derived tile property: gmma_major_a.

parameters.name: gmma_major_b
parameters.description: Tunable or derived tile property: gmma_major_b.

constraints.expression: GMMA major mode is compatible with global and shared layouts
constraints.rationale: The WGMMA descriptor interprets operand strides according to its major mode.

constraints.expression: selected Atom method supports requested major modes
constraints.rationale: Not every WGMMA wrapper supports every operand layout.

references.evidence: The referenced CUTLASS builder/core expression implements this tile decision.

notes: Rule-extracted parameterized method; requires semantic review before promotion to curated.
